commits.message:
test(table): pin every box style's frame against Python Rich (rich-table-6uy.4) (#95)

The epic's three fixes were each verified by hand against the reference and
then left with nothing standing guard over them. This adds that guard: the
rendered frame of all nineteen shipped box constants, in two configurations,
compared against a fixture generated by running Python Rich itself.

Deriving the fixture from the reference rather than from this library is the
whole point. A golden generated by running the code under test can only notice
that a frame changed, never that it was wrong to begin with — expectation and
subject would be the same code. Generated from Rich, it is an independent
oracle, and it passed on its first run: 19 constants x 2 configurations agree
with the reference character for character, which is the first mechanical
confirmation that .3's audit was right.

For the same reason there is no regenerate flag. Re-accepting whatever this
library currently prints would launder a regression into the fixture; the
committed command in the test's header re-derives it from Rich instead, and is
verified to reproduce the file byte for byte.

The `header-footer-lines` configuration is the only shape that draws all eight
lines of the grid — anything less leaves three undrawn, which is how three
missing separator sets survived in `Box` until .3. Single-character footers and
digit cells route around rich-table-css and .5 so the fixture does not pin a
known defect.

Verified by negative control, each reverted one at a time: building the header
separator from the row set (.1) fails; drawing the header content row with the
body set (.2) fails; collapsing HEAVY_HEAD's foot separator onto its row
separator (.3) fails, on exactly that one line of exactly that one constant.

Filed rich-table-6uy.6 while writing this: a table with `showHeader: false`
keeps its header-specific glyphs, so a default table renders a heavy top border
over a light bottom one. The reference substitutes the whole box for five
constants and this port does not. Reproduced, not inferred — which is why the
headless configuration is absent from the fixture rather than pinning the
defect.
